scientific_step_complete_only_when: required replay/certification gates passed or explicit scientific negative result recorded
reproducibility bundle and SHA-256 sidecar created
Google Drive upload to campaign_checkpoints verified

principle: Decoder is the scientific execution and authority surface. Chat/session tooling may orchestrate, monitor, interpret, checkpoint, and package, but must not become a parallel science engine.

rules.reason: Prevents scientific logic from drifting into chat-only or ad hoc side paths.
rules.rule: All new Infinity Grid algebra science must be implemented in Decoder before it can become authoritative.

rules.reason: Question, dependencies, handler, scope, promotion status, and replay identity must be frozen before results are seen.
rules.rule: Every scientific experiment or audit must be registered before execution in the applicable Decoder scientific registry. G-uplift/G-ladder work uses src/infinity_grid/resources/uplift/G_UPLIFT_EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY_V1.json; legacy/general registered scientific targets use the Decoder scientific test registry where applicable.

rules.reason: Avoids the S5/S6 replay-provenance mistake and preserves one scientific implementation path.
rules.rule: Do not create an authoritative stage-specific science engine, notebook, one-off script, or chat-side implementation outside Decoder. External wrappers may only launch a registered Decoder-native handler, monitor it, checkpoint/copy files, verify outputs, or package evidence; they may contain no stage-specific scientific decision logic.

rules.reason: The interactive chat/tool path has repeatedly failed around long-running work; execution must survive UI/session interruption.
rules.rule: Nontrivial scientific runs, full regressions, cold replays, large reconstructions, and any task that may approach the interactive runtime limit must be launched detached/background from the start. Foreground chat execution is reserved for short checks expected to finish comfortably below the interactive limit.

rules.reason: Do not claim background execution merely because a command was issued.
rules.rule: After launching a background run, verify that the controller is genuinely detached or otherwise session-independent, record PID/process identity, run root, logs, state/checkpoint path, and confirm the process is alive before reporting it as running.

rules.reason: Background execution must not sideline Decoder.
rules.rule: Detached controllers supervise registered Decoder execution only. Scientific calculations and classification logic stay inside Decoder modules/handlers.

rules.reason: Scientific authority is more important than completion.
rules.rule: Any mismatch in source identity, registry identity, authority, checkpoint integrity, replay identity, manifest, or science hash stops advancement. Do not silently continue, reinterpret, or patch around a mismatch.

Checkpoint deterministic stages/chunks. On restart, verify integrity and resume only missing work. Reuse completed verified checkpoints; rerun completed heavy work only when integrity or semantics require it.

rules.reason: Independent source/materialization without changing the scientific implementation.
rules.rule: Certification cold replay reruns the same registered Decoder-native experiment from cold source/materialization and compares the declared stable scientific payload exactly.

rules.reason: Prevents operational and scientific conclusions from being conflated.
rules.rule: Report execution/reproducibility status separately from scientific outcome. A scientifically negative result can be an execution PASS; an execution failure is never a scientific negative result.
Reconnaissance/audits marked non-promoting cannot alter graduation, observer, state descriptor, or next-level authority unless a separately registered promotion/graduation gate earns it.

Every completed scientific step and every important rescue/checkpoint gets a compact reproducibility ZIP containing the frozen question/spec, exact code/runner identity, human and machine results, manifests/checksums, runtime/dependencies, checkpoint/state information, and necessary intermediate evidence without redundant bulk.

rules.reason: Local sandbox/session storage is not durable project completion.
rules.rule: Every scientific completion, closeout, and important rescue/checkpoint must be uploaded to Google Drive folder campaign_checkpoints together with its SHA-256 sidecar.

rules.reason: Upload intent is not storage verification.
rules.rule: Verify Google Drive presence after upload. Do not tell the user a checkpoint/closeout is safely saved or complete until the ZIP and checksum are confirmed in campaign_checkpoints.

rules.reason: The Decoder should be sufficient to continue without reconstructing state from chat history.
rules.rule: After a graduation, major scientific closeout, protocol repair, or frontier change, update the Decoder machine-readable documentation/current handoff so a new chat can recover the exact code and scientific state quickly.

rules.reason: Prevents stale summaries or historical motivation from overriding exact evidence.
rules.rule: When sources disagree, newest exact certified correction/result artifacts outrank machine handoff snapshots; current machine documentation outranks old handoffs and chat summaries; historical theory/cosmology documents are not premises for the finite algebra programme.
Status responses should state done / running / to come, identify the actual active stage, and avoid implying work continues when no verified process is alive.

rules.reason: Avoids duplicating S1-S6 style programmes or wasting long computations.
rules.rule: Do not repeat earlier ladder stages merely to repair packaging, orchestration, or certification plumbing unless their scientific authority or semantics are actually invalidated.

scope: Infinity Grid Algebra Decoder scientific work, execution, certification, checkpointing, handoff, and storage
